Who we are

Haryana Chemical and Pharmaceuticals

Haryana Chemical and Pharmaceuticals (HCP) is a trading and procurement firm supplying chemical and pharmaceutical raw materials from established manufacturers to industrial, pharmaceutical, personal-care and commercial buyers.

We help purchase teams match the right grade to their formulation, obtain manufacturer batch documentation and plan deliveries to their plant — with supply always subject to availability, applicable grade, specification and batch documentation.
